The source workbook carries no version, date or change log. Version 1 is therefore dated from the file family and no date is invented. 22 November 2026 is the date of this run (Template and Rules section R8.1). No release date is changed and no date is raised as a gap (Template and Rules section R1 U7).

Three additions, all taken from Template and Rules: the acceptance criteria origin tag (section R7.2, section 7), the contract mock Given for a dependency of class C (section R5.4 and section R5.5 DP-11, section R7.2 section 12.8), and the -ITG suffix on the integration copy of a test case (section R7.2 section 16). Two rows are added to 'Sentence frames' and two to 'Code prefixes', and the new sheet 'Realignment additions' explains them. Every keyword, sentence frame, word, code prefix, number and example of version 1 is kept as it stands; no row is edited, renumbered or removed.
The four line keywords Given, When, Then and Scenario, with the reading label, the Thai word and what the line is doing. Unchanged.
The 55 sentence patterns of version 1 unchanged, plus the contract mock Given and the origin tag at the end of a Scenario line.
The words that carry the meaning, in order of how often they appear in the acceptance criteria, with kind and meaning. Unchanged.
The 15 code prefixes of version 1 unchanged, plus the acceptance criteria origin tag and the -ITG test case suffix.
How the three additions work with their source section, example and owner; the contract fake of each of the 19 services from the Ownership Map; and the four questions this work package leaves open.
